title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Notice on Matters Concerning Jurisdiction of Basic People's Courts over First-Instance Intellectual Property Civil and Administrative Cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing Matters Concerning the Jurisdiction of Basic People's Courts over First-Instance Intellectual Property Civil and Administrative Cases

Fa [2025] No. 167

The High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In accordance with the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction over First-Instance Intellectual Property Civil and Administrative Cases" (Fa Shi [2022] No. 13) and in light of the actual practice of intellectual property adjudication, the Supreme People's Court has adjusted the basic people's courts that have jurisdiction over intellectual property civil and administrative cases and their respective jurisdictional areas. This notice is hereby issued and shall take effect on October 1, 2025.

The "Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Standards for the Jurisdiction of Basic People's Courts over First-Instance Intellectual Property Civil and Administrative Cases" (Fa [2022] No. 109) shall be simultaneously abolished. Cases that have already been accepted before the implementation of this notice shall still be handled in accordance with the original standards.

This is hereby notified.

September 23, 2025

Matters Concerning the Jurisdiction of Basic People's Courts over First-Instance Intellectual Property Civil and Administrative Cases
